capabilities: Generate summaries, tags, and concepts from notes
Explore related notes in a sidebar connection graph
Search indexed notes with natural-language questions
Import Apple Books highlights as annotation notes
Research notes and highlights with optional web search
disambiguation: Not a mind-map drawing tool; it shows related-note connections in a sidebar graph and writes AI-generated summaries, tags, and concepts into note properties.
extras: Desktop-only; Apple Books import and web research require macOS. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Web research is off by default and requires consent.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in local AI for generating note metadata, surfacing related notes, or searching the vault with natural-language questions.

relations.evidence: Mindmap is desktop-only and uses Ollama for note processing.
Web research requires consent and sends derived search queries to Exa, not raw notes or highlights.
Import Apple Books highlights and connect them to your ideas.

summary: Local AI plugin that summarizes notes, suggests tags and links, and answers natural-language questions over your vault using Ollama.
